units.source_text: “唔唔……唔唔……”痛苦的呻吟声渐渐高了，

en.t: “Mm, mm... mm, mm...” The groans of pain gradually grew louder,

units.source_text: “不应该老是畏首畏尾，以为在这人世间长命百岁地活下去就行。

en.t: “One should not always live in fear and think it is enough simply to survive in this world to the age of a hundred.

units.source_text: 啊，总理大臣（当时大隈担任总理大臣）是以五十年为一日的心情生活过来的。

en.t: Ah, the prime minister (Okuma was prime minister at the time) has lived with the feeling that fifty years are as one day.

units.source_text: 啊，我动不了，太遗憾了，太遗憾了。”

en.t: Ah, I cannot move. It is such a pity, such a pity.”
